# Cash day-end answers

Answers of one lab row on BRIDGE CASHDAY LAB, a synthetic book, on TallyPrime 7.2 Silver, 2 Nov 2026 (#1761), byte for byte as Tally sent them, by raw requests.

- `window-20250401-20250430.utf16le.xml`: the plain voucher window of April 2025, the book's ten vouchers.
- `trial-balance-to-*.utf16le.xml`: the Trial Balance from the first day of the books to the date in the name.

The reference section is 12a.25 of `docs/tally/TALLY_PROTOCOL_REFERENCE_MEASUREMENTS_AND_OPEN_QUESTIONS.md`.
